messages:
maria_s: Heads up — tenant 8421 is missing ~25m of audit events in their SIEM (2026-03-10 02:00-02:25 UTC). Customer escalated. Forwarder logs show KMS decrypt failures and some zero-byte manifests. Repro steps I ran below.

maria_s: Repro (quick):
```
# check forwarder status
curl -sS https://internal-forwarder/tenants/8421/status | jq .
{ \"state\": \"PENDING\", \"last_processed_shard\": \"20260310-01\" }
# tail forwarder logs
grep \"8421\" /var/log/forwarder/forwarder.log | tail -n 50
2026-03-10T02:03:12Z WARN forwarder: kms: Decrypt failed: AccessDenied request-id=aa11bb tenant=8421 shard=20260310-02
2026-03-10T02:04:01Z ERROR forwarder: s3: object size 0 for manifest=.../8421/20260310-02.manifest
```

maria_s: Not sure if this is related to last night's KMS alias rotation (we rotated alias-redwood-priv at 02:00 UTC).

kevin-r: I saw partial replay attempts for 8421 around 02:10. SIEM got ~8k events then stopped. Looks like batching/backpressure + decrypt failures caused the forwarder to skip a shard.

adrian.k: Can you paste the forwarder IAM role and KMS key alias in use? If the role lost kms:Decrypt for the new alias that would explain AccessDenied. Also check if the HSM policy requires a new external principal mapping.

maria_s: forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::111222333:role/forwarder-processor-tenant-8421
KMS alias in tenant config: alias/redwood-priv-2026-03-10

tara: I'm on KMS. We rolled alias/redwood-priv -> key-arn:arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111222333:key/abcd-rotated at 02:01 UTC. Policy change included a new principal mapping for dedicated-hosts/* but I didn't add forwarder-processor role (my bad). Rolling a policy patch now.

adrian.k: Suggestion: do not replay directly into SIEM until we confirm manifest integrity; replay to a temp bucket and verify checksums. Also verify manifest object Content-Length > 0 and gzip header.

kevin-r: I'll queue a targeted replay for 8421 into temp-bucket/replays/8421/ and then run an indexer dry-run to confirm payloads look correct. ETA 30m.

audit-exporter-bot: policy-change detected for alias/redwood-priv-2026-03-10 by tara at 2026-03-10T02:01:12Z. Notifying owners.

tara: Patch applied: added forwarder-processor-tenant-* role to key policy and granted kms:Decrypt. Please test and confirm.

maria_s: retested tail of forwarder logs after patch:
```
2026-03-10T02:12:33Z INFO forwarder: KMS decrypt succeeded request-id=cc22dd tenant=8421 shard=20260310-02
2026-03-10T02:12:35Z INFO forwarder: replay queued to temp-bucket/replays/8421/20260310-02
```

kevin-r: Replay completed to temp bucket. Ran indexer dry-run: all events look valid, SIEM ingestion rerun shows +14,120 events for that window. There are still small gaps 02:05-02:08 (~120 events) — likely due to ephemeral backpressure and zero-byte manifest earlier. We're reprocessing those shards now.

adrian.k: Action items:
- tara: confirm KMS policy audit + add a pre-rotation checklist to include forwarder roles.
- kevin-r: complete replay and verify SIEM receipts + file replay manifest.
- maria_s: notify customer and copy compliance with timeline.

maria_s: assigning to folks now. Thanks for quick triage. Can we also add a short playbook for alias rotations (who to notify, check list, canary tenant)? :thumbsup:

kevin-r: will update incident thread with receipts and S3 manifests.

adrian.k: I'll draft the KMS pre-rotation checklist and HSM mapping note, then we can add to runbook.

maria_s: closing the Slack thread for now — will reopen if replays reveal more gaps. Thanks all. :rocket:
